The '''''Surgica Galactica Journal''''' was one of the foremost publications on the current state of medicine throughout the galaxy, published during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Several of articles dealing with the problems and necessities of operating on [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were popular during the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
